reddit.title: Introducing New Features: When the Colony Talks Back
reddit.body: We've made significant improvements to how your colony communicates with you! No longer will you have to click around to understand what's happening. With thought badges for settlers, a problem-alert stack, and dynamic stats, your settlement now speaks for itself. Check out the details here: https://provincia.ch/devtalk/when-the-colony-talks-back?utm_source=reddit&utm_medium=social&utm_campaign=when-the-colony-talks-back
